evidence.quoted_text: self.assertTrue(any(q["items"][-1].get("run", {}).get("launch_pending") for q in saved if q["items"][-1].get("run")))
evidence.reason: The assertion is genuinely generation-agnostic: `saved` is initialized once at line 535 and appended on every `save_queue` call at line 548 across the 1/2/3 loop. At line 563 it checks any snapshot whose last item has a `launch_pending` run, but it never ties that snapshot to the current `item` or `run_id`. Thus generation 1's persisted reservation can satisfy the assertion for generations 2 and 3 even if those generations never persist a reservation, making the test's reservation check falsely pass. The current contract does not address this test detail, so ordinary test-correctness semantics govern.
